name: Deep Wilderness Dungeon
accessNote: The only Fire giant location for Krystilia assignments. Located around level 53 Wilderness near the Mage Arena, with high player-killer risk. Cannon tiles are available along the western lava pool, and a safespot is in the south-eastern tunnel near the Monk of Zamorak. Wilderness Medium Diary unlocks a 46 Agility shortcut between fire and hill giants.
